bias.en: Bearish · bounced off $321–324, at the 5-day average
bias.zh: 偏空 · 自 $321–324 反弹至 5 日均线

read.en: Broadcom rose 2.3% on Oct 26 to $329.17, trading between $323.30 and $332.12. It is just below the falling 5-day average ($329.3) and below the falling 10-day ($335.8), 30-day ($349.1), 100-day ($373.0) and 200-day ($367.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 15 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($353.84), and RSI is 40.
read.zh: 博通 10月26日上涨 2.3%，收于 $329.17，盘中区间 $323.30–332.12。股价略低于下行的 5 日均线（$329.3），并低于下行的 10 日（$335.8）、30 日（$349.1）、100 日（$373.0）和 200 日均线（$367.8）。MACD 自 10月15日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$353.84），RSI 为 40。

read.en: The low held the $321.4–324.1 zone and the close moved back above it; the $332.1 high faded. Resistance is $329.3–332.1 (5-day, Oct 22 and 26 highs), then $335.8 (10-day, Sep 16 low) and $341.1 (Oct 20 high). Support is $321.4–324.1, then $320.2 (Oct 23 low) and $314.1. A close above $332.1 would target $336–341; a close below $320.2 would open $314.

s.en: Dec 17 and Oct 10, 2025 lows zone ($321.4–324.1); Oct 26 low $323.3
